summary: Sanders has made Arkansas a fiscal and diplomatic partner of Israel, announcing a $25–50 million investment in Israeli government bonds and describing her meeting with Netanyahu as cementing an 'unbreakable bond.' On the third anniversary of October 7, her remarks centered on Hamas and she called it 'disgusting and shameful' to use the attacks as an excuse to repeat Hamas talking points. She also signed SB 352, embedding IHRA language into Arkansas school conduct codes.
